name: @antv/x6 v3 + React shape
summary: The X6 v3 React path, using the official @antv/x6-react-shape 3.0.1 package. A React 19 spike rendered 20 interactive React nodes and 20 edges with selection; the cost is a browser-only stack, no npm provenance and a React shape package that is close to its 12-month release boundary.
gains: Official React shape package instead of a custom DOM bridge
Custom React nodes with working component state
Selection and panning work in the browser spike
losses: Browser-only: native Node ESM/CJS loading still fails
No npm provenance for X6 or the React shape package
React shape 3.0.1 is close to 12 months old
Bundle includes React and X6: 782.82 KB / 231.62 KB gzip in the spike
React provider API and panning behaviour differ from v2

spike.scenario: 20 React-rendered nodes, 20 edges, official @antv/x6-react-shape 3.0.1, React 19.2.0, Selection plugin, Vite production build, 1200x800 Chrome screenshot.
spike.notes: React nodes render through foreignObject. A node button click updated component state and selection worked. The bundle includes React 19.2.0; the vanilla X6 v3 spike is 584.85 KB / 168.82 KB gzip. Native Node/SSR loading still fails, so this is a browser-only path.
